questions.questionText:
Which of the following geometric relationships best represents the classes:
Animals, Dogs, and Pets?
options: Two intersecting circles completely outside a third circle
Some dogs are pets, all dogs are animals, and some pets are animals

Step 2: Check intersection relations (can an element be both B and C?).
Step 3: Deduce the Venn diagram topology: Some dogs are pets, all dogs are animals, and some pets are animals.
questions.memoryTip: Universal Inclusion = Concentric. Partial Overlap = Intersecting. Zero Connection = Disjoint.
